user.title: Connect to a ControlByWeb 400 series module
user.description: For 400 series modules (X-400, X-401, X-404, X-405/406, X-408, X-410, X-412, X-417, X-418, X-420). Use the Administrator login, or the User login if you enabled a Control Page password; leave the password blank if none is set.

model.title: Which model is this?
model.description:
Connected. Found: {summary}.
The model is shown on the device in Home Assistant. The module can't report its own model (and may include I/O linked from other modules), so this is a best guess; please confirm or change it.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the device or read /state.json
error.unsupported_device: The device answered, but not like a 400 series module (no state.json). Other ControlByWeb families, such as older WebRelays, are not supported.

data.onewire_unit: Fallback unit for 1-Wire sensors (only used if the device doesn't report one)
